text:
auditor_claire: Hi team — auditor here. For the upcoming SOC2/ISO spot-check I need a concise evidence bundle covering RBAC change approvals and KMS activity (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt) for 2025-02-18 03:00-04:00 UTC. Please confirm artifacts and handoff plan.

omar: I'll collect logs and do the initial correlation. plan: cloudtrail KMS events, STS AssumeRole traces, ticket export for approvals, and the incident responder notes if relevant.

sarah: evidence-bot created task EVID-8123 and added checklist.

evidence-bot: Task EVID-8123 created, assignee: omar, priority: high.

auditor_claire: We need chain-of-custody: exact export commands, Splunk job ids, S3 put metadata, and checksums. Also need a short control mapping to SOC2 points (access controls, logging, change mgmt).

omar: Splunk savedsearch I'll run: "evidence_kms_rbac_2025_02_18_v1". query: ```index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey OR ReEncrypt) earliest=1750626000 latest=1750629600 | table _time,eventName,userIdentity.arn,requestParameters.keyId,sourceIPAddress,eventID```

sarah: for role correlation: `index=auth_events event=AssumeRole | table _time,sessionName,userIdentity.arn,eventID` then join on eventID/sessionName.

auditor_claire: Redaction: redact external user IPs and emails, but keep internal service CIDRs and principal ARNs. Include a redaction manifest describing salted-hash mapping.

omar: will include `redaction_manifest.txt` with rationale. Packaging plan: 1) export ndjson files; 2) include savedsearch JSON and job id; 3) include CLI commands used; 4) tar+gzip the bundle; 5) compute sha256 and gpg-sign the checksum. Example commands to include in bundle: `splunk search "savedsearch=evidence_kms_rbac_2025_02_18_v1" -output json > kms_events.ndjson` and `tar -czf evid_e8123_bundle.tgz kms_events.ndjson sts_assume.ndjson okta_approvals.pdf incident_notes.md redaction_manifest.txt` then `sha256sum evid_e8123_bundle.tgz > evid_e8123_bundle.sha256` and `gpg --armor --detach-sign evid_e8123_bundle.sha256`

sarah: upload plan: put to `s3://redwood-evidence/e8123/` with SSE-KMS and `x-amz-meta-uploader=omar`. We'll capture the PutObject CloudTrail event and include it as `s3_put_event.json`. presign created with `aws s3 presign` and shared via secure channel.

auditor_claire: Provide the Splunk job id and savedsearch version so we can rerun exactly. Also include the `aws kms list-grants --key-id` output and `describe-key` snapshots for any key mentioned.

omar: saving job id: 1204556671. I'll include `savedsearch_def.json` and `job_1204556671.json`. Also will run `aws kms list-aliases --key-id <id>` and put the output in `kms_aliases.json`.

sarah: For evidence of RBAC approvals, export the ticket thread to PDF and include a screenshot of the approval UI with timestamp metadata. For SSO proof, include Okta audit lines with `eventId` and hashed user id; no raw tokens.

auditor_claire: Also need proof keys are ephemeral per policy. Include CreateKey/RotateKey/CreateGrant/DeleteGrant events +/- 24 hours and a short narrative `key_lifecycle.md` tying events to policy.

omar: added those events to the savedsearch. We'll store the lifecycle notes in `key_lifecycle.md`.

sarah: vuln triage note: if any KMS activity matches a CVE timeframe we'll add `vuln_notes.md`. Preliminary scan shows no matching CVEs.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Evidence handoff review meeting scheduled 2025-02-18T11:00Z — join https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/9876543210

omar: bundle assembled and uploaded. presign sent to auditor_claire. manifest sha256: b94f6f3e1a2c4d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1

auditor_claire: checksum verified. I'll validate control mapping and reproduction steps. If anything missing I'll reopen. thanks team.

sarah: retention note: artifacts retained 365 days under legal hold, then archived per policy. Closing thread unless auditor requests more.
